findings.location: Lines 1–17, entire draft; e.g. “Ownership is the promise that a thing remains yours after the money changes hands.”
findings.what: The draft maintains a restrained, abstract, carefully qualified essay register, unlike the corpus’s consistently conversational, polemical, and aggressively colloquial register.
